description: SSM patch scan is stale or lacks verified successful scan evidence
rationale: Patch observation freshness is evaluated independently from SSM Agent connectivity. A new OperationEndTime or a successful Install does not prove a successful Scan; missing scan evidence is a coverage gap, not proof a scan never occurred.
remediation: Confirm successful AWS-RunPatchBaseline Scan invocation, update inventory and investigate stale or missing scan evidence; validate on-host patch state.
